title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 4 verified (after fix round 2).

What I checked:
- CI is green on `c2f342d` (lint, typecheck, test, build) and the Vercel preview deployed.
- Order: `test: fix masked select must not record a value that matches an option (#3)` comes before `fix(recorder): do not record the value of a masked select (#3)`. The fix commit touches no test file.
- The test fix only drops the `value: "****"` expectation on the masked select (that expectation was the bug) and asserts the select has no `value`. No other test was removed, skipped or loosened. A new test covers options of different lengths and a `value` attribute written in the HTML, and checks that no star string on the select matches exactly one option.
- `applySelect` deletes the select `value` when its value is masked, including a `value` from the HTML. With `maskAllInputs: false` outside a masked region the value is still recorded as typed, and that test is unchanged.
- Together with round 1, a masked select now records neither `selected` nor a `value`, so the chosen option cannot be read from the output.
- Requirements from Part 4 still hold: password values never appear, masked text keeps its length, blocked elements keep width and height.
- ADR 0018 exists and supersedes only the select value point of 0015. The 0015 status line, `docs/decisions/README.md` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` are updated.
- Commits are authored as the owner with the `Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent` trailer.

Next: Part 5.
